gaps: Partner-centre search pages (/en/search?...) render no results via WebFetch; course URLs were taken from each site's sitemap.xml. Only generic named pathway pages (International Foundation / Year One / Year Two / Pre-Master's in <subject>) were collected.

NOT collected: the many degree-specific integrated pathway pages (slugs like 'bsc-... -with-international-year-one', '...-with-international-foundation', 'msc-...-with-pre-master-s', '...-with-international-year-two') at Newcastle (~21), City St George's (~15 Year One + ~16 Pre-Master's), Exeter (~40), Stirling (~120), QUB (~30), UEA (3). Only one City example (MSc Finance with Pre-Master's) was included. Fees/terms for these were not verified.
INTO Manchester and INTO London list no pre-master's courses on their course list pages. UEA and INTO Exeter generic pages show no pre-master's.

Course pages state the programme's tuition for 2026/27 (provisional) or 2027/28 pricing basis; Stirling pages say figures are indicative 2025/26 and cover only the ISC portion. Fees are 'first-year' as shown on the page.
Durations are listed as '3 terms and 4 terms' side by side on many pages (2026/27 vs 2027/28 headings); mapping to entry route is unclear and is given as shown.

Intakes are derived from term start dates and months named on pages; where a page only mentions a 'published September start date' without dates, it was not counted. Newcastle International Year One in Engineering and QUB International Foundation for Science and Engineering: intakes null (no intake month clearly stated). Some Lancaster/Stirling pages have apparent labelling inconsistencies for September/January blocks.
English requirement 'min writing/subskill' values reproduced as extracted; Newcastle/others note higher scores for some progression degrees (e.g. Law) not captured.
Progression degree lists are empty on most pages ('No results found' in the dynamic table); progression text uses prose on the page only.

INTO London partner_university set to a descriptive group because pages name guaranteed-offer universities rather than a single host; Stirling 'International Year Two' (slug international-diploma-in-...) classed as Pathway; Newcastle foundation names follow page titles, which differ from URL slugs.
Not in scope/skipped: Academic English, pre-sessional, study abroad, Stirling 'pre-masters-english-and-study-skills' and 'online-pre-masters-english-and-research-skills'.
